units.title: Actual fixed-spectrum first-order reply
units.reader_note: The exact reply formula is shown first; the full family, assumptions, formula proof and precise Lean are folded below.
units.statement: The actual precision–matrix reply is the genuine Euclidean gradient and determines the centered quadratic value.
assumptions: \(d\in\mathbb N,\ d\ge2,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge2\). Fix any full real \(O\in O(d)\), allowing either determinant sign, and every \(x\in\mathbb R^d\).

For \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), and \(A=A_\kappa=O\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)O^\top\). The Lean index \(j\in\mathrm{Fin}(d)\) represents \(i=j.\mathrm{val}+1\).

The potential is exactly \(f_A(x)=x^\top Ax/2\), with zero additive constant. The response is exact precision multiplication \(q_A(x)=Ax\), not covariance multiplication \(A^{-1}x\) or the primitive hidden-rotation response \(Ox\).

The proof produces actual Fréchet derivative existence at every point, then identifies Lean’s total \(\mathrm{gradient}\). Differentiability, symmetry, admissibility, a gradient certificate and reply correctness are not added assumptions.

The private consumer uses the same hidden \(O\) for \(A_2\) and \(A_\kappa\). It reconstructs \(g=(\kappa-1)A_2x-(\kappa-2)x\), then the actual pair \((\langle x,g\rangle/2,g)\). Reference \(2\) is the condition-number parameter. The selected direction has no reciprocal or inverse-reply premise.

This is pointwise in the latent matrix; the mathematical parameter \(O\) is not an algorithmic disclosure of the eigenbasis. Random seeds, Haar laws, adaptive transcripts, query budgets and sampling accuracy are outside this statement.

notation.text: Exact precision response, the same action as a continuous linear map, and the reference-2 precision using the same hidden rotation.

steps.title: Obtain symmetry of the actual precision
steps.text: Use the existing canonical admissibility result for this literal source matrix. Its positive-definite output supplies Hermitian symmetry internally; no regularity certificate is assumed.
steps.lean: hA is the Hermitian projection of actual_precision_admissible hd hκ O. Mapping self-adjointness through Matrix.toEuclideanCLM gives hH. This one existing actual admissibility declaration is the sole direct ASTIS producer parent.

steps.title: Identify the same Euclidean quadratic
steps.text: The matrix action and the continuous linear map have identical coordinates. The ordinary coordinate dot product therefore agrees with the Euclidean inner product for the same potential.
steps.lean: hquery is the actual coordinate-preserving map identity. Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM and real ring algebra establish hf, without changing f or introducing an additive constant.

steps.title: Differentiate the actual function
steps.text: Differentiate the identity map and the continuous linear map, then the inner product and multiplication by one half. This directly constructs a Fréchet derivative.
steps.lean: hraw uses hasFDerivAt_id, H.hasFDerivAt, the canonical inner-product derivative and const_mul. This is a derivative-existence proof, not an evaluation of a default gradient.

steps.title: Use symmetry to obtain the genuine gradient
steps.text: Symmetry makes the two derivative terms equal. The resulting derivative is exactly the Riesz functional associated with Hx, so the actual gradient exists and equals the response.
steps.lean: hlin identifies the continuous linear derivative with toDual of Hx, using hH and real_inner_comm. hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt produces hgrad; hg.gradient identifies the total gradient only after existence.

steps.title: Assemble the exact first-order reply
steps.text: Combine the proved gradient with the coordinate value identity. The same actual precision response determines both entries of the first-order observation.
steps.lean: Prod.ext combines the actual value equality with hg.gradient. The exact original source signature and all binders remain unchanged.

steps.title: Consume the actual reference-precision reply
steps.text: In the focused Test, the existing same-rotation affine provider converts the actual A2 reply into the actual Aκ action. Substitute it into the new derivative and pair results, giving the genuine observation of the κ potential.
steps.lean: The private Test actually invokes FixedSpectrumAffine.actual_affine_precision_query and the new actual_first_order_query. Its two direct kernel ASTIS parents are those exact canonical declarations. Only the forward affine output is consumed; no inverse/nonzero bridge, count assertion or extra producer premise is used.

units.lean_statement: Exact literal source precision, centered potential and precision reply; genuine HasGradientAt output and actual value/gradient pair at every point.
units.lean_proof: The adjacent exact source proves derivative existence through the real inner-product derivative and actual symmetry. Its single ASTIS parent is actual admissibility. The private Test separately combines new producer and canonical actual affine provider; it is not another public or Registry node.
units.boundary: This proves actual pointwise fixed-spectrum derivative existence, value/gradient reconstruction and its genuine same-O forward-affine consumer. It does not close C-infinity/Hessian/strong-convexity/smoothness/unique-minimizer claims. It supplies no operational one-query or finite-horizon cap theorem, adaptive/private-seed/transcript/output-law equivalence, Gaussian-target or sampling-TV transport, finite-precision or arithmetic-cost theorem, or expected-cost conversion. Both full main lower bounds, their distinct dimension/condition-number/accuracy ranges, remote acceptance and postmerge purification/Exposition Seal remain separate.
